title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Documentation-only release: the README was fully rewritten with complete feature coverage, updated copy, and eight animated GIFs — no changes to extension behavior.

highlights.title: Rewritten README
highlights.description: The README now covers every major feature with concise copy and eight animated GIFs, giving prospective users a clear visual preview of the extension before installing.

highlights.title: New Feature Sections
highlights.description: Dedicated sections for the onboarding walkthrough, Code Lens, and the AI assistant were added to improve discoverability of features that were previously underdocumented.

highlights.title: No Behavior Changes
highlights.description: No extension commands, settings, or navigation logic were modified — existing installations behave identically to v1.5.0.

sections.heading: Packaging and Docs
bullets: Rewrote the README with complete, accurate coverage of all major features: Go to Definition, Find Usages, Code Lens, Test Navigation, onboarding walkthrough, AI assistant, String Folding, and Inlay Hints.
Added eight animated GIFs to the README — one per feature area — so users can see each capability in action before installing.
Added dedicated sections for the Code Lens, walkthrough, and AI assistant features, which lacked dedicated documentation in previous versions.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No changes to extension behavior, commands, settings, parsing, or navigation logic. This release is documentation only.
